items.t: Engine damage from over-revving on a missed downshift
items.job: Cylinder head repair or engine replacement
items.note: Range runs from a valve job to a used replacement engine. Costs rise if pistons are damaged.

items.t: Burning oil on early cars
items.job: Install oil catch can or updated oil-jet bolts; monitor oil
items.note: A full ring job costs far more and is rarely needed if oil is kept topped up.

items.t: Cracked valve spring retainers
items.job: Valve adjustment and upgraded valve spring retainers
items.note: Cost is much higher if a valve has already dropped.

items.t: Timing chain tensioner rattle
Grinding or notchy shifts into second gear
items.job: Replace transmission fluid; replace synchronizers if needed
items.note: A fluid change is a small job; replacing gear sets and synchros means removing and rebuilding the transmission.

items.t: Transmission pops out of gear
items.job: Repair transmission shift parts per Honda bulletin

items.t: Buzzing or noisy clutch pedal
items.job: Replace clutch, release bearing and pressure plate
items.note: Only needed if the clutch is worn; a buzz alone is often left alone.

items.t: Torn or worn convertible top
items.note: Aftermarket tops cost less than genuine Honda tops.

items.t: Plastic rear window creased, scratched or cloudy
items.job: Replace rear window or upgrade to glass-window top

items.t: Water leaks from the soft top in car washes
items.job: Adjust or replace soft top weatherstrips

items.t: Creaks and rattles from the closed top
items.job: Lubricate top pivots and shim latches

items.t: Heater blower motor overheats and blows its fuse
items.job: Replace heater blower motor and clear cooling hose

items.t: A/C water dripping into passenger footwell
Whistling from the vents when A/C is on
items.job: Replace A/C expansion valve and recharge

items.t: Check engine light from a failed EVAP solenoid
Check engine light after long drives (software)
Air/fuel sensor failure
Hesitation under hard acceleration
Clicking or creaking from the rear axles
Popping noise from front upper control arm
items.job: Front upper control arm mount repair

items.t: Dashboard bubbling or wrinkling
VSA stability control module failure
items.note: Used or rebuilt units cost less.

items.t: Seat belt retractor can lock up (recall)
items.note: Free at a Honda dealer if not already done. Check your VIN.

items.t: Seat belts don't retract with the top down (recall)
items.note: Free at a Honda dealer if not already done. Check your VIN.

items.t: Taillight side reflectors don't meet standards (recall)
items.note: Free at a Honda dealer if not already done. Check your VIN.
